ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

2. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.

21. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Soil ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Sound ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
